message:
test(ka-pc): a child ended by closing its job is judged on an explicit crash-close record, never on a job that is just gone (Codex evidence candidate r1, managed r1 FAIL)

The managed e2e's shell-crash step closed viewer-C's job by hand and set it null; the shared Child then could not
confirm the end (10-29 run: 1 FAILED, the child had in fact ended). Now the step goes through Child::CrashCloseJob,
which records, before the close, kill-on-close read back, the root in the job and the job's listed members being the
root plus only the OS console host (conhost.exe), then the close's success and the root's end. End accepts only that
whole record (with EOF and the log kept) and writes what it rests on into the trailer. A null job without the record,
a failed close (the job kept for cleanup, not counted), a descendant in the job, a root that does not end, and a host
are refused. Ordinary children keep the job-terminate verdict unchanged (the trailer gains one evidence line).
ka_pc_e2e_child_test: the old step still refused, the new step accepted, the refusals provoked; ALL PASS.

Product, UI and the shared guard unchanged against aecbdfd. No e2e was run.
